title: The hidden difference
speech: Two people. The same booking app. Both reach confirmation. One gets a quick path. The other gets a surprise total and repeated work. Would your team see the difference?

title: Meet Journey Lab
speech: During this hackathon, I built Journey Lab to help teams understand the experiences their products create. AI personas explore a working product with different goals, knowledge, and constraints. Every journey leaves evidence we can inspect.

title: Meet Alex and Maya
speech: This is Gather, our example booking app. Alex needs a room for twelve, with a projector, within three hundred fifty dollars. Maya needs the same setup, but her limit is two hundred fifty. That difference changes the journey.

title: Follow the experience
speech: Meta’s Muse Wonder explores the interface from each persona’s perspective, making choices as it goes. Alex books through the quick flow. Maya sees a room for two hundred twenty dollars. At review, it becomes two eighty. She changes rooms—and her meeting name disappears. She has to enter it again.

title: Make the invisible visible
speech: Maya still completes her booking. But success hides the extra work. Journey Lab connects her recorded reactions to the exact moments behind them. Click a point on the emotional arc, and see what happened. These are simulated perspectives that help us investigate.

title: Turn understanding into action
speech: Now that evidence becomes an improvement. Muse Code creates an isolated candidate that shows the full price earlier and preserves entered details. We can inspect the change, review it, and retest both personas before deciding what to ship.

title: Watch the difference
speech: In fresh recorded sessions, Maya sees the suitable two-hundred-forty-five-dollar option earlier. Her booking takes six actions instead of twelve. Alex keeps his quick path. The prices haven’t changed. The experience has. Side by side, we can see how—and check the evidence.

title: More perspectives in view
speech: The ambition goes beyond booking: help a small team explore more perspectives, find friction earlier, and bring better questions into real user research. A parent on a phone. A first-time customer. Someone working within a strict budget. More of their constraints can shape what we build.

title: One product. Many journeys.
speech: Journey Lab. One product. Many journeys. Build with more perspectives in view.
